title: 第15章 宗师巅峰吴海第16章 宗门排名大赛
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 清风城主神色有些压抑，说道：“秦叶这小儿难道以为突破到了先天就能为所欲为吗？”
“城主，不是秦叶出手，根据探子回报是另外一个未知强者出手。”
“清风宗竟然还藏有一位先天强者……嘶！”
城主神色连续变换，最终叹了一口气，说道：“我知道了。”
宗门的事情，作为王国官员本就不应该插手，现在清风宗竟然有两名先天强者，靠他一个城主府是万万不能得罪的。
“清风宗突然出现两名先天强者，这件事情透露着古怪，还是上报吧。”
揉了揉眉心，城主低声自语道。
而城主不知道的是，秦叶此时已经进了清风城。
他打听到最近城里来了一个老头，厨艺非常不错，于是亲自上门。
那老头现在栖身在城东一家酒楼里，秦叶见到他时，他还在忙着烧菜。
那老头年龄大约在七十岁左右，白发苍苍，身材瘦弱，佝偻着腰，背影看起来像是随时可能倒下。
“小哥，这里是厨房，闲人是不能进来的。”老头微微转过身，看着秦叶笑着说道。
秦叶打量了这老头两眼，并没有发现什么奇怪之处，出于习惯，就让系统探查一下。
“系统，探查他的个人资料。”
“宿主，稍等！”
“叮，探查完毕。”
【人物】：吴海
【种族】：人族
【修为】：宗师九重巅峰（中毒状态，实力下降到先天）
【功法】：乾元掌，摧魂功
秦叶无语，本来只想找一个厨师回去，哪曾想竟然遇到一个宗师境强者，而且还是差一步就突破到大宗师。
不过幸好对方实力下降，要不然秦叶二话不说掉头就走。
“叮！新任务激活，将吴海招揽到清风宗，奖励宿主100年修炼经验。”
我去，发达了啊。
这奖励太丰厚了，100年修炼经验下来，恐怕得到宗师境界。
一下子就突破到宗师，这奖励简直不要太爽，不要白不要。
“小哥，小哥……”老头看到秦叶发呆，叫了两声。
秦叶回过神来，双眼发光的看着老头，自己能不能突破到宗师就看这一波了。
“你可知道清风宗？”秦叶故意问道。
“小人听说过，听说秦宗主年轻有为，年纪轻轻的就是先天强者，万人敬仰。”老头点头哈腰地说道。
要不是秦叶从系统里看到他的资料，还真的被他骗了。都说人老成精，诚不欺我。
“我就是清风宗宗主。”秦叶表明身份。
老头一愣，在秦叶进来的那一刻，他就已经认出了秦叶的身份，只是不知道秦叶来这里的目的，他自认为自己伪装的非常好，不会有人能看出他的伪装。
content_en:
The Lord of Qingfeng City looked a little depressed and said: "Does this kid Qin Ye think that he can do whatever he wants if he breaks through to the innate level?"
"City Lord, it was not Qin Ye who took action. According to the spies' report, it was another unknown strong person who took action."
"Qingfeng Sect actually hides an innate powerhouse... Hiss!"
The city lord's expression changed continuously, and finally he sighed and said, "I understand."
As a kingdom official, you should not interfere in the affairs of the sect. Now Qingfeng Sect actually has two innate powerhouses, and the city lord's mansion must not offend him.
"Two innate strong men suddenly appeared in Qingfeng Sect. This matter seems strange. We should report it."
Rubbing his eyebrows, the city lord whispered to himself.
…
What the city lord didn't know was that Qin Ye had already entered Qingfeng City at this time.
He found out that an old man had recently come to the city and his cooking skills were very good, so he came to his door in person.
The old man is now living in a restaurant in the east of the city. When Qin Ye saw him, he was still busy cooking.
The old man was about seventy years old, with gray hair, a thin figure, a stooped waist, and his back looked like he might collapse at any time.
"Brother, this is the kitchen, idlers are not allowed in." The old man turned around slightly, looked at Qin Ye and said with a smile.
Qin Ye looked at the old man and found nothing strange. Out of habit, he let the system investigate.
"System, explore his personal information."
"Host, wait a moment!"
"Ding, the investigation is complete."
[Character]: Wu Hai
[Race]: Human race
[Cultivation]: Grandmaster Ninth Level Peak (poisoned state, strength dropped to innate)
[Kung Fu]: Qian Yuan Palm, Soul Destroying Technique
"..."
Qin Ye was speechless. He originally just wanted to find a chef to go back, but he never expected that he would meet a strong master in the master realm, and he was still just one step away from breaking through to the grand master.
Fortunately, the opponent's strength has declined, otherwise Qin Ye would turn around and leave without saying a word.
"Ding! A new mission is activated. Recruit Wu Hai to the Qingfeng Sect and reward the host with 100 years of cultivation experience."
Let me go, it’s developed.
This reward is so generous. After 100 years of cultivation experience, I am afraid I will reach the master level.
Breaking through to Grandmaster in no time, this reward is simply too satisfying and should not be wasted.
"Brother, little brother..." The old man saw Qin Ye in a daze and called out twice.
Qin Ye came back to his senses and looked at the old man with shining eyes. Whether he could break through to the Grandmaster would depend on this wave.
"Do you know Qingfeng Sect?" Qin Ye asked deliberately.
"I've heard about it. I heard that Sect Leader Qin is young and promising. He is an innate strong man at a young age and is respected by thousands of people." The old man nodded and said.
If Qin Ye hadn't seen his information from the system, he would have been deceived by him. They say that people become better with age, so I won’t be deceived.
"I am the leader of Qingfeng Sect." Qin Ye revealed his identity.
The old man was stunned. The moment Qin Ye came in, he had already recognized Qin Ye's identity, but he didn't know the purpose of Qin Ye coming here. He thought that he was disguised very well and no one would be able to see his disguise.
title_en: Chapter 15 Grandmaster Peak Wu Hai Chapter 16 Sect Ranking Competition
